{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The greatest asset of the American economy is the hard-working American.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The primary goal is getting people back to work by fostering growth that creates jobs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This goal unites all sections of the platform.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This goal runs through commitments on education and workforce development.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This goal underlies the approach to welfare reform.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This goal underlies the approach to regulatory reform.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"This goal drives the determination to advance trade agreements that multiply opportunities for workers at home.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration and its agents at the National Labor Relations Board are determined to reverse change.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration is attacking the franchise model of business development, which is essential to the flexibility and creativity of the new economy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration is wielding provisions of the Fair Labor Standards Act from the 1930s, designed for a manufacturing workplace, to deny flexibility to both employers and employees.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration has repealed union transparency rules that allowed members to discover what was being done with their dues.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The current Administration has outlawed alternatives to unions even when they were favored by the workers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
